item.title: How Does Kotlin Code Actually Run on iPhone? The KMP Compilation Pipeline Explained
item.description: Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) compiles Kotlin code into native iOS ARM64 machine code through Kotlin/Native and LLVM. This article breaks down the full 7-step compilation pipeline from Kotlin source to LLVM IR, Objective-C bridging, and Swift interop, with performance insights and build optimization tips.
